# Sensitive-lexicon Attribution

The empty nickname and chat word tables retain attribution to the original
[Sensitive-lexicon](https://github.com/konsheng/Sensitive-lexicon) integration,
based on commit `d967c30b053fa40b06c5a0dddf0be493f2dfae46`.
The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`.

This source distribution contains no vocabulary entries or dictionary-generation
tools. The compiled empty tables are in:

- `src/features/characters/generated/name_policy_words.inc`
- `src/features/chat/generated/message_policy_words.inc`

Nickname and chat text still undergo encoding, length and format validation.
